title: Peptoide als potenzielle antibiotische Wirkstoffe gegen multiresistente Bakterien
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: There are fewer and fewer treatment options available for treating multi-resistant germs. In this work, peptoids were investigated as a possible class of substances for the therapeutic application of infections with multidrug-resistant bacteria, showing their antimicrobial activity against gram-positive bacteria, gram-negative bacteria, mycobacteria and fungi.
